description:
Project Solar Tail

Project Solar Tail is an experiment focused on improving vanilla ship AI on select ships.

Always DELETE the old version before extracting the new one

Requires MagicLib

Safe to add mid-save.

FEATURES

A special AI on select ships, using a score-based approach to make combat decisions. Improves fleet coordination and general decision-making across the affected ships. A system with a handcrafted fleet to show the AI in action. An unusual flagship with unique abilities. Second in Command integration: fully compatible with Second in Command, featuring a tailored suite of Executive Officers (XOs), if enabled.

CREDITS
